http_api.ownerSymbol: UiRuntime server semantic GET/SSE and observation GET routes
http_api.contract: The observation route parses optionalI2ReadScope, the scope subtree, node selection and decodeTaskAgentActivitySelectionQuery, then calls UiRuntimeService.scopedObservation.

load_task_truth.contract: The shared resolver selects the serve-bound live source or the declared project/mode durable inventory. Foreign admissions come from that inventory, not the serve-bound requirementAdmissions map. The same selected task scope supplies already owner-decoded native allocation, active-turn, resumed-segment, child invocation and delivery, review, and Planner records. Those typed facts are the actual-execution source; assignment-graph fact replay is not required. Missing or unavailable sources remain explicit.

project_semantic_views.ownerSymbol: selectTaskAgentActivity and the Runtime pure actual-execution selector boundary
project_semantic_views.contract: The Runtime pure selector classifies the same selected task scope's typed native records without stores, logs, Manager creation, acquire, rebind, or writes. Existing RuntimeAgentActivityProjection.actualExecutionGraph then carries the contracts source through packages/ui/projection/actual-execution-graph.ts. Guidance, current plan, and recorded instances stay distinct; exact missing relations remain ungrouped or unavailable.

project_status_and_actions.contract: UiRuntimeService builds node facts before this projection. task.output is projected only from authoritative committed public publication; missing publication is explicit and raw execution evidence is not presented as final output.

browser_view.ownerSymbol: shared semantic observation panel scope and finite-stream handling
browser_view.contract: The UI-owned api.observation fifth parameter carries the complete taskScope projectKey/mode. The existing scope query remains the observation subtree and node remains the selected node; the agent query keeps the existing decoder. Both formal pages consume the same agentActivity read and actualExecutionGraph carrier without a second fetch. Presentation keeps guidance, current plan, and actual-recorded instances separate; technical IDs and commit refs stay in detail, while unavailable and ungrouped records remain visible.
